description: Japantown seed events published by the steward account (events.iriai.app, D-26). Each seed is a real, sourced event approved by Daniel on 2026-10-12, with dates, times and addresses confirmed by him (BUILD-006); times are local San Francisco time with their UTC offset. Records reference the named-place list for their location. A published seed records its record keys under "published", and a later edit to it updates both records in place.

seeds.name: Kabuki Theatre Appreciation Class with JETAANC
seeds.description: Monthly kabuki theatre appreciation class with JETAANC at the Japanese Cultural and Community Center of Northern California, held on the third Thursday of the month. Free, donations welcome.

seeds.name: Anime Cinema Club: "Perfect Blue" Remastered
seeds.description: Anime Cinema Club screening of Satoshi Kon's "Perfect Blue" (remastered) at New People Cinema. Doors open at 6pm, screening at 6:30pm. Tickets $10, $15 VIP.

seeds.name: Kendo with San Francisco Kendo Dojo
seeds.description: Kendo practice with San Francisco Kendo Dojo at the Japanese Cultural and Community Center of Northern California.

seeds.name: Introduction to Yosakoi Dance Workshop with Ito Yosakoi
seeds.description: Introductory yosakoi dance workshop with Ito Yosakoi at the Japanese Cultural and Community Center of Northern California, also offered online.

seeds.name: Udon Making Workshop
seeds.description: Hands-on udon making workshop at the Japanese Cultural and Community Center of Northern California.

seeds.name: 20th Annual Curry Cook-Off
seeds.description: The Japanese American Religious Federation's 20th annual curry cook-off, benefiting Kinmon Gakuen, at Christ United Presbyterian Church (Sutter St at Laguna). Tickets $17 presale, $20 at the door, $8 for kids, free under 4.

seeds.name: Family Treasures Marketplace, Kimono Sale and BWA Boutique
seeds.description: Family treasures marketplace, kimono sale and Buddhist Women's Association boutique in the BCSF Gymnasium at the Buddhist Church of San Francisco. Open 11am to 4pm on Saturday Oct 24 and Sunday Oct 25.
